## Hidden bibliography

This document uses citations but suppresses the bibliography block in Typst output.
The `#show bibliography: none` rule is injected, so citation references remain functional while the bibliography section is hidden.

Knuth's TeXbook [@knuth1984] and Lamport's LaTeX guide [@lamport1994] are classic references.
